decisions.reason: The source requests clearer identification of the D2D PDF in the delivery package; it does not change the existing 302-page D2D cover specification.
Distinguishing the delivered Amazon and D2D PDFs does not change the requirement that the Amazon PDF upload successfully or the existing lower-size backup export rule.
The source uses the existing 300-page Amazon specification to identify the correct PDF but does not modify that cover specification.
The PDF variant-identification request does not alter the completed blurb replacement or reflow behavior.
The source concerns identifying platform-specific PDF files and does not change the title typography consistency requirement.
The request to distinguish the Amazon and D2D PDFs does not modify any cover-text rendering or font-portability requirement.
